app.author: privong
app.description: Functional programming language with macro-based development
proposed_tests: Download and run Racket interpreter with a hello-world program
Verify correct macro-based development and compile-time evaluation
Check for any memory leaks or performance issues during large-scale programs
Compare compilation speed between Racket and Scheme
